content.text:
Clean A/B that nails the defect — same repo, same tool, **one phrase difference**:

| query | rank 1 | rank 2 | rank 3 | rank 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| "…normalization in markdown" | **gold** `markdownUtils.ts` (12.28) | blogUtils.ts | PendingNavigation.tsx | normalization.ts |
| "…normalization in markdown**/MDX processing**" | i18n-tutorial.mdx **(22.85)** | i18n-tutorial.mdx v3.0.1 (22.85) | i18n-tutorial.mdx v3.1.1 | **gold** (demoted to #4) |

Adding "MDX" makes the token match `.mdx` *documentation* via `exact-code-token`, scoring 22.85 — nearly 2× the gold's 12.28 — and **three versioned copies of the identical tutorial** take the entire podium. The agent, following our own doctrine ("the top hit is the fix site"), goes to a translation tutorial, then searches 9 more times.

Two concrete bugs, both general and both already scoped to the ranking agent:
1. `exact-code-token` over-weights matches in prose/doc content — a filename-extension token shouldn't outrank a symbol-name + signature + path match in source.
2. No near-duplicate collapse — 3 identical versioned copies consumed 3 of 4 top slots.

This is why the frugality-vs-correctness prompt tuning kept going in circles: I was tuning agent behaviour around a ranking defect. Fixing rank-1 precision recovers *both* the lost instance and the 3.4 wasted searches/session.

## DOCUSAURUS-9897 REPRO
Query `"CRLF line ending normalization in markdown/MDX processing"`, `--profile full --top-k 10 --max-snippet-lines 6`.

- BEFORE: gold `packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownUtils.ts` = **rank 4**. Ranks 1/2/3 = `versioned_docs/version-2.x|3.0.1|3.1.1/i18n/i18n-tutorial.mdx`, all score 22.8525.

- Dedup proof (same repo, doc-intent query `"documentation guide for CRLF…"`): BEFORE ranks 1-4 = four copies of `i18n-tutorial.mdx` @22.408. AFTER = one hit, `signals=body,exact-code-token,+3 similar`, identical score 22.408 (prior correctly OFF for a doc-intent query). Three slots freed.

## WHY gold_top3 IS FLAT (metric artifact, not a null result)
`graph_quality_score.py` scores `gold_files` = every non-test file in the SWE-bench patch. 3/14 gold sets contain **prose**: `phpspreadsheet→CHANGELOG.md`, `axum→axum/CHANGELOG.md`, `gson→UserGuide.md`. The probe pays for ranking a changelog.

Net top3: `docusaurus-9183` null→2 (**+1**), `phpspreadsheet-4214` 1→6 (**−1**, and rank-1 before was `CHANGELOG.md`, not the fix). Sum 0.

|---|---|---|
| primary_top3_rate | 0.4286 | **0.5714** |
| primary_any_rate | 0.7857 | **0.8571** |

Per-instance primary rank (before→after): carbon 1→1, ripgrep ∅→∅, caddy 2→**1**, docusaurus-9183 ∅→**2**, fluentd 1→1, fmt 1→1, gin ∅→∅, gson 1→1, phpspreadsheet 7→**6**, preact 5→5, lombok 8→**7**, redis 2→2, axum 4→**3**, vue 10→**9**. **Six improve, zero regress.**

## WHAT THE PRIOR KEYS ON
Whole path **segments** + extension + basename. No repo/file/symbol/query names anywhere.

| class | trigger | prior |
|---|---|---|
| source | default | 1.0 |
| doc | `.md .markdown .mdx .mdoc .rst .adoc .asciidoc .txt .text .org .pod .rdoc .textile .creole .wiki`, man pages `.1`–`.9`/`.roff`/`.man`; segments `doc docs documentation man manual(s) website(s) wiki handbook guide(s) tutorial(s) versioned_docs versioned_sidebars changelog(s) javadoc godoc`; basenames `readme changelog changes history news contributing authors maintainers code_of_conduct license copying notice governance upgrading` | 0.5 |
| vendored | segments `vendor(s) _vendor third_party third-party thirdparty dependencies node_modules bower_components jspm_packages site-packages dist-packages godeps .venv venv virtualenv eggs .eggs external(s)` | 0.5 |
| generated | existing `searchGeneratedArtifactPath` + lock manifests (`package-lock.json yarn.lock Cargo.lock go.sum poetry.lock …`) | 0.5 |
| example | segments `example(s) sample(s) demo(s) cookbook(s) recipes playground` | 0.75 |

Multiplier on the **positive** part of score only (negative scores untouched — scaling them would *undo* an existing demotion). **Not a filter**: doc still ranks #1 when it is the only match (unit-tested). Prior → 1.0 when the query names the class (`documentation`, `readme`, `changelog`, `vendored`, `dist`, `example`, …). Applied once, post-dedupe, pre-selection, on both the semantic and sparse lists. Disclosed as `doc-prior`/`vendored-prior`/`generated-prior`/`example-prior` in `signals`.

`0.5` chosen a priori = "a non-editable hit must be **2×** as relevant as the best source hit to outrank it". `0.75` = mild tilt for example code. Also folded `searchDocumentationArtifactPath` onto the same taxonomy, so the pre-existing additive `−6` and the new multiplier can never disagree on "documentation" (this is what fixes `.mdx` + `versioned_docs/`, which the old `strings.Contains("/docs/")` substring test missed entirely).

## DEDUP RULE
Collapse requires **all** of: distinct files, same basename, not different monorepo units (reuses existing `searchMonorepoUnit`), normalized text ≥ 96 chars, and (identical normalized text **OR** path-equal-modulo-version-segments with token Jaccard ≥ 0.9). Survivor = highest-scoring, gets `+N similar`. Version segments = `version-2.x`, `v2`, `3.0.1`, `2.x`, `release-1.2`, `latest/next/stable/current/unreleased`. Genuinely different `client/v2` vs `client/v3` code is preserved by the Jaccard gate (tested).

## SENSITIVITY — AND WHAT I REFUSED
Non-source prior swept 0.35 / 0.5 / 0.65:

| prior | progress | gold_top3 | gold_any | **primary_top3** |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.35 | 0.4446 | 0.6429 | 0.8571 | 0.5714 |
| **0.5 (shipped)** | 0.4446 | 0.6429 | 0.8571 | **0.5714** |
| 0.65 | **0.4732** | **0.7143** | 0.8571 | 0.5000 |

**I refused to ship 0.65 even though it hits the stated target.** Its extra point comes entirely from `phpspreadsheet-4214`, where `rank_gold=3` is `CHANGELOG.md` while the real fix site `Round.php` sinks to 7 (vs 6 at 0.5), and axum's fix site goes 3→4. The weaker prior scores better *by doing more of the thing this ticket asks me to stop doing*. That is metric-tuning, so `0.5` stands. 0.35↔0.5 is a plateau — behavior is insensitive across that range.

Also refused:
- A `locale/` `i18n/` `.po` `.properties` "localization resource" class. It is arguably a general class, but in this set it moves exactly one instance (phpspreadsheet 6→~4, still not top-3). Zero measured benefit, non-zero risk → not shipped.
- Exempting `CHANGELOG` from the doc prior. That would recover the phpspreadsheet/axum probe points and is pure overfit — a changelog entry is a project convention, not the fix.
- Any conditional on repo, path literal, symbol, or query string. There are none in the diff.

Not addressed (out of scope, not this defect class — I inspected all of them): `ripgrep-2209`, `gin-3227`, `preact-3689`, `vuejs-core-11870` misses are genuine semantic-ranking limits with no doc/duplicate noise in their top 10. Hand-tuning for them would be overfitting.

## CHANGED

New `internal/sem/search_enclosure.go` — snippet allocator, runs after the byte fitter:
- **snap to true symbol bounds** — hit's enclosing *callable* span from the graph's own symbol records (`SymbolID`, else smallest enclosing callable at the focus line). Beats the fixed line window and beats the region, which the ranker clips at `MaxRegionLines` (redis: region 794-873, real symbol 796-879).
- **rank-ordered budget** — payload may grow ≤1 KiB; the rest is funded by demoting tail results to 2-line locators. Head 3 never demoted. Among fitting plans, most rank-discounted complete bodies wins, ties to cheapest — so the tail pays before the allowance does.
- **graceful degradation** — >160-line symbol, container kind, unresolved symbol, unreadable file → keeps its window. Never exceeds budget.
- `SIMILAR_TO` added to graph expansion (near-duplicate = second site needing the same change).
- Stats `complete_symbol_snippets` / `locator_snippets` (1.x additive, omitempty).

Generalizes because nothing keys on repo/file/symbol; it's a byte-allocation policy over the graph's own spans. Probe instances untouched.

Both graph fixes are merged to main and running in the benchmark. Where the goal stands:

**Tool fixes landed (main, all tests green — 950 Go + 104 shell):**

| fix | effect | verified by |
|---|---|---|
| file-class prior + dup collapse | docs no longer outrank source; gold rank 4→2; fix-site top-3 0.43→0.57, 6 improve/0 regress | +61 tests, refused the metric-gaming 0.65 setting |
| enclosing-symbol snippets | `encl_cov` 0→2/14, `encl_frac` 0.068→0.168 | +28 tests, 6/6 mutations caught |
| combined | `gold_any` 0.786→**0.857**, progress 0.4446→**0.4862** | probe, guards_ok=1 |
| `eg-q` empty-search bug | was returning nothing whenever `EG_PROFILE` unset | end-to-end replay |
| cmm ungimped | `moderate` index (semantic exists), semantic+regex+trace_path+pagination | real output, 2 vendor claims falsified |

**Running:** haiku-30, baseline 21/30 and cmm 20/30 done, eg restarted on the combined binary.

Honest read on the 35% bar: the single-instance smoke gave eg −19% vs a frugal baseline on a task with almost nothing to explore, and the ranking fix removes ~3.4 wasted searches/session on the harder ones. Whether that reaches 35% against a *frugal* baseline is genuinely unknown — the frugal baseline is the strict comparison and no one has run it clean until now. If it lands short I'll say so and go after the next lever (zero-turn locate), not restate the target.
